cohort: 97 women at 37-42 weeks gestation undergoing induction of labor at Ahmadu Bello University Teaching Hospital (ABUTH) Zaria between June 2019 and February 2020.
finding: Transperineal ultrasound cervical length (TPUS-CL) and fetal head perineum distance (FHPD) measurements are better predictors of IOL outcome than a simplified Bishop score, particularly in primigravidae.
